Sam H: Morning all — quick async check:
- Done: landed kernel prefetch PR (link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4521)
- Observed: microburst tail latency spikes on 4k batch tests (~95th->99th jump)
- Logs: ```
[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] kv_fetch(ms): p50=1.2 p95=12.4 p99=45.8
[2026-03-17T08:12:09Z] batch_exec(ms): p50=2.1 p95=18.6 p99=62.0
``` 
Blocker: need help triaging whether KV eviction or batch slotting is causing it.

Jess L: Nice. Can you paste command used to run microburst? I want to repro locally.

Sam H: Sure — `./run_bench --scenario microburst --seq 1024 --clients 16 --kv-hot=0.2`

Maria P: Re: eviction — I saw similar in canary when prefetch TTL was 5s. Try bumping to 20s and see.

Derek K: Ping me when you open the canary. I can watch metrics and nudge autoscaler. @Sam H please include tracing header: `X-Runtime-Id`.

Sam H: Will do. Opening canary in us-west with 10% traffic. Canary link: https://canary.redwood.ai/5643

deploy-bot: Canary created by Sam H — build bld-2026-03-17-0345. Autoscale on. Logs streaming: https://logs.redwood.ai/streams/5643

Jess L: Quick code review: added a fallback to non-prefetch path if kv returns timeout. Left a small comment in PR.

Sam H: Thanks! I'll address comments. Plan for today: triage canary, try TTL bump, run 50 runs with `--trace=1`, follow up with perf table.

Maria P: If you need a quick script to aggregate p95/p99 across runs, I have one: `scripts/agg_latency.py` — ping me and I'll run it.

Derek K: I'll keep an eye on SLOs and revert if we see user impact >1% error.

Sam H: Sweet. Will post results by EOD. :thumbsup:
